change: repair-open-workbench-reconnection: D42 abandoned runtime recovery and complete explicit Quit
scope_note: Desktop Windows candidate only; no new public release is authorized by this fix. All test/native homes and secrets are isolated on D. Native Windows job and DPAPI integration uses real production binaries. Unit child process probes prove ownership/containment boundaries and do not substitute actual formal DSH application evidence. Existing legacy state receives separately authorized one-time exact-byte operator archival; missing journals never become automatic idle. Changed-boot branches have strict parser/state coverage; no actual OS reboot is claimed. Darwin/Linux cross-compilation is not native-runtime acceptance. Same-boot active Unix recovery without exact process-tree containment remains refused; cleanup checks every retained managed PGID. Local desktop full suite excludes the existing Git-worktree-creating test due explicit user prohibition. Formal running/HTTP and complete Quit receipts are generated by the read-only runner against the exact installed candidate; no frames, latency, account re-login, remote SSH connectivity or overnight acceptance is inferred.
